name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: Drumsticks, eggplant, peppers, and cherry tomatoes on one pan. The oven does everything, and the vegetables cook in the chicken's fat.
time: About an hour, most of it in the oven

proteins.name: Chicken drumsticks
proteins.timing: On the pan from the start, 40–45 minutes, turned once. Done when the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

proteins.name: Eggs
proteins.timing: No meat. Cracked into gaps on the pan for the last 6 minutes.

steps.text: Toss the vegetables and the salted drumsticks with the olive oil. Spread everything on a sheet pan with room between the pieces.
Roast until the skin is crisp and the eggplant has collapsed. Eggs: crack them into gaps on the pan for the last 6 minutes.

leftovers: Pull the leftover meat off the bone while it's warm. It's two rice bowls.
